headline: Trillo's single completes 15th-inning rally over Cubs
recap: The Phillies trailed the Cubs 5-3 entering the bottom of the 15th and won 6-5. Lonnie Smith and Pete Rose drew walks, Bake McBride's groundout scored one run, and Garry Maddox's single scored Rose to tie it. Keith Moreland singled and Larry Bowa walked to load the bases, and Manny Trillo singled to center to bring in Maddox with the winning run.

The Phillies led 2-0 after a third-inning double by Pete Rose. Jerry Martin's fifth-inning home run cut it to 2-1, and the Cubs went ahead 3-2 in the seventh on Bill Buckner's double and a force out. The Phillies tied it in the bottom of the seventh, and it stayed 3-3 through the 14th. Larry Christenson started for the Phillies and allowed three runs on four hits over 6.1 innings, striking out four. Rick Reuschel started for Chicago and gave up one earned run over 6.1 innings.

Six Phillies relievers followed Christenson, in order: Tug McGraw, Ron Reed, Sparky Lyle, Warren Brusstar, Dickie Noles and Kevin Saucier. Saucier got the win. Trillo finished 3 for 7, and Chicago's Dennis Lamp took the loss.
